purpose: Test whether horse-specific fast/slow track-speed suitability adds stable predictive value beyond ability/course context.

track_speed_definition.base: winner-time residual versus venue x surface x distance x class historical baseline
track_speed_definition.pre_race_signal: official going-condition prior blended with strictly earlier same-day same-surface race residual when available

interpretation: Track speed itself is measurable and earlier same-surface races provide useful context when available.
Horse-specific fast/slow surface preference estimated from up to 10 prior starts is too noisy and does not add stable held-out predictive value.
Even an oracle current-race track-speed signal did not improve the 2026 horse-level top-3 model, so the limitation is not only pre-race speed estimation.
Do not add a fast/slow suitability grade or score to the production app at this time.
Re-test after more future data or a richer historical sample per horse becomes available. Track speed may be shown later as context-only, not as a ranking input.
